alternatives: whenever I go to Spain, I will come to you
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "I will come to you" after "Spain", completing the broken sentence; the earliest manuscripts do not have it, and the SBLGNT leaves it out. Reviewers must check the apparatus.

decisions.choice: to be sent on: to be helped on a journey with supplies and company
decisions.reason: προπέμπω was the custom of equipping a traveler with food, money and companions for the next stage (1 Corinthians 16:6, Titus 3:13). Paul hopes the church in Rome will support his mission to Spain.

decisions.choice: first filled with you in part: after enjoying your company for a while
decisions.reason: To be "filled" with people is to enjoy their company to the full. "In part" (ἀπὸ μέρους, as in verse 15) adds that the visit will be short, or that he cannot have his fill of them.

decisions.choice: serving the holy ones: bringing the gift for the believers in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: διακονέω is the word for service of others, here the collection he is taking (verse 26; 2 Corinthians 8:4). The holy ones are God's people, the believers there (1:7).

decisions.choice: completed as separate sentences
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the break with dashes; Balanced and Readable write sentences a reader can follow, without adding to the sense.

decisions.choice: take help to
decisions.reason: Readable says what the service is, as verse 26 explains.

decisions.choice: rassasié de [votre présence]
decisions.reason: The Greek "filled with you" means enjoying their company (meaning decision); French cannot say "rassasié de vous" naturally, so Literal supplies the word in brackets.

source.text: εὐδόκησαν γὰρ Μακεδονία καὶ Ἀχαΐα κοινωνίαν τινὰ ποιήσασθαι εἰς τοὺς πτωχοὺς τῶν ἁγίων τῶν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ.

records.literal_gloss: Were pleased for Macedonia and Achaia a sharing some to make for the poor of the saints of the in Jerusalem.

en.L: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make some sharing for the poor of the holy ones in Jerusalem.
en.B: For the churches of Macedonia and Achaia were glad to share what they had with the poor among God's holy people in Jerusalem.
en.R: The believers in Macedonia and Achaia were happy to give money to help the poor among God's people in Jerusalem.

es.L: Porque Macedonia y Acaya se complacieron en hacer alguna participación para los pobres de entre los santos que [están] en Jerusalén.
es.B: Porque las iglesias de Macedonia y Acaya se alegraron de compartir lo que tenían con los pobres del pueblo santo de Dios en Jerusalén.
es.R: Los creyentes de Macedonia y Acaya se alegraron de dar dinero para ayudar a los pobres del pueblo de Dios en Jerusalén.

sw.L: Kwa maana Makedonia na Akaya waliona vema kufanya ushirika fulani kwa ajili ya maskini wa watakatifu walioko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Kwa maana makanisa ya Makedonia na Akaya yalifurahi kushiriki mali zao na maskini kati ya watakatifu wa Mungu huko Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Waamini wa Makedonia na Akaya walifurahi kutoa fedha kuwasaidia maskini kati ya watu wa Mungu huko Yerusalemu.

fr.L: Car la Macédoine et l’Achaïe ont bien voulu faire un certain partage en faveur des pauvres parmi les saints qui [sont] à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Car les églises de Macédoine et d’Achaïe ont été heureuses de partager ce qu’elles avaient avec les pauvres du peuple saint de Dieu à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Les croyants de Macédoine et d’Achaïe ont été heureux de donner de l’argent pour aider les pauvres du peuple de Dieu à Jérusalem.

decisions.choice: Macedonia and Achaia: the churches of northern and southern Greece
decisions.reason: These were Roman provinces: Macedonia with Philippi and Thessalonica, Achaia with Corinth. The names stand for the believers there, who gave to the collection (2 Corinthians 8:1-4, 9:2).

decisions.choice: a sharing: a contribution that expresses fellowship
decisions.reason: κοινωνία is fellowship, sharing in common. Here it is a gift of money, but the word keeps the sense that giving expresses a bond (2 Corinthians 9:13).

decisions.choice: the poor among the holy ones: some of the believers, not all
decisions.reason: The genitive picks out a group: the poor who were among the believers in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: were pleased: chose gladly, of their own will
decisions.reason: εὐδοκέω is to think it good and choose it willingly. Paul stresses that the gift was freely given (2 Corinthians 8:3).

decisions.choice: the churches of (B); the believers in (R)
decisions.reason: English does not use a place name for the people in it as freely as Greek; Balanced and Readable name them.

decisions.choice: ushirika
decisions.reason: "Mchango" (a contribution) names only the money. "Ushirika" is fellowship and sharing at once, as the meaning decision describes the gift; Balanced and Readable say what was shared.

source.text: εὐδόκησαν γάρ, καὶ ὀφειλέται εἰσὶν αὐτῶν· εἰ γὰρ τοῖς πνευματικοῖς αὐτῶν ἐκοινώνησαν τὰ ἔθνη, ὀφείλουσιν καὶ ἐν τοῖς σαρκικοῖς λειτουργῆσαι αὐτοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: They were pleased for, and debtors they are of them; if for in the spiritual of them shared the Gentiles, they ought also in the fleshly to serve them.

en.L: For they were pleased [to do it], and they are their debtors; for if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual [things], they ought also to serve them in material [things].
en.B: They were glad to do it, and they really do owe it to them. If the Gentiles have come to share in their spiritual blessings, they ought also to serve them with material help.
en.R: They were happy to do this. But they also owe it to them. The people who are not Jews have shared in the spiritual blessings that came from the Jewish believers. So they should also help them with the things they need to live.

es.L: Porque se complacieron [en hacerlo], y son deudores de ellos; porque si los gentiles han participado de sus [cosas] espirituales, deben también servirles en las [cosas] materiales.
es.B: Lo hicieron con gusto, y de verdad se lo deben. Si los gentiles han llegado a compartir sus bendiciones espirituales, también deben servirles con ayuda material.
es.R: Se alegraron de hacerlo. Pero también es algo que les deben. Los que no son judíos han recibido parte de las bendiciones espirituales que vinieron de los creyentes judíos. Por eso deben ayudarles también con las cosas que necesitan para vivir.

sw.L: Kwa maana waliona vema, na wao ni wadaiwa wao; kwa maana ikiwa watu wa mataifa wameshiriki katika mambo yao ya kiroho, wanapaswa pia kuwatumikia katika mambo ya kimwili.
sw.B: Walifurahi kufanya hivyo, na kweli wanadaiwa nao. Ikiwa watu wa mataifa wamepata kushiriki baraka zao za kiroho, wanapaswa pia kuwatumikia kwa msaada wa mahitaji ya kimwili.
sw.R: Walifurahi kufanya hivyo. Lakini pia ni deni walilo nalo kwao. Watu wasio Wayahudi wameshiriki baraka za kiroho zilizotoka kwa waamini Wayahudi. Kwa hiyo wanapaswa pia kuwasaidia kwa vitu wanavyohitaji ili kuishi.

fr.L: Car elles l’ont bien voulu, et elles sont leurs débitrices ; car si les nations ont eu part à leurs [biens] spirituels, elles doivent aussi les servir dans les [biens] matériels.
fr.B: Elles l’ont fait de bon cœur, et elles le leur doivent bien. Si les nations ont eu part à leurs bénédictions spirituelles, elles doivent aussi les servir par une aide matérielle.
fr.R: Ils ont été heureux de le faire. Mais c’est aussi une dette qu’ils ont envers eux. Ceux qui ne sont pas juifs ont reçu leur part des bénédictions spirituelles venues des croyants juifs. Ils doivent donc aussi les aider pour ce dont ils ont besoin pour vivre.

decisions.choice: they were pleased ... and they are debtors: freely given and yet owed
decisions.reason: Paul repeats "they were pleased" from verse 26 and adds that the gift is also a debt. Both are true: a free gift and a fitting return.

decisions.choice: their spiritual things: the blessings of the gospel that came through Israel
decisions.reason: The gospel, the promises and the Messiah came to the Gentiles from the Jewish people and from the church in Jerusalem (9:4-5, 11:17-18).

decisions.choice: material things: what the body needs
decisions.reason: σαρκικός here means belonging to bodily life, such as food and money, not sinful (as in 1 Corinthians 9:11).

decisions.choice: serve: a word for public and priestly service
decisions.reason: λειτουργέω is related to "minister" in verse 16. The gift is a service to God's people, almost an act of worship.

decisions.choice: spiritual blessings ... material help (B); things they need to live (R)
decisions.reason: English needs nouns for the plural adjectives; Readable says plainly what material things are.

decisions.choice: the Jewish believers
decisions.reason: Readable names who "they" are, from the context: the believers in Jerusalem, and through them Israel.

decisions.choice: elles (L, B); ils (R)
decisions.reason: French pronouns agree with the noun they refer back to: Macedonia and Achaia (L) and "les églises" (B) are feminine, "les croyants" (R) masculine. The Greek "they" means the believers of those provinces at every level.

source.text: τοῦτο οὖν ἐπιτελέσας, καὶ σφραγισάμενος αὐτοῖς τὸν καρπὸν τοῦτον, ἀπελεύσομαι δι’ ὑμῶν εἰς Σπανίαν·

records.literal_gloss: This therefore having completed, and having sealed to them the fruit this, I will go away through you into Spain;

en.L: So, having completed this and having sealed this fruit to them, I will set out by way of you to Spain;
en.B: So once I have finished this task and made sure they have received this fruit, I will set out for Spain and visit you on the way.
en.R: When I have finished this job and safely given them this gift, I will leave for Spain and visit you on my way.

es.L: Así que, después de haber completado esto y de haber sellado para ellos este fruto, partiré hacia España pasando por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}};
es.B: Así que, cuando haya terminado esta tarea y me haya asegurado de que ellos reciban este fruto, saldré para España y {{plural_you:los|os}} visitaré de camino.
es.R: Cuando haya terminado este trabajo y les haya entregado este regalo sin problemas, saldré para España y {{plural_you:los|os}} visitaré en el camino.

sw.L: Basi, nitakapokuwa nimelimaliza jambo hili na kuwathibitishia kwa muhuri tunda hili, nitaondoka kupitia kwenu kwenda Uhispania;
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nitakapokuwa nimemaliza kazi hii na kuhakikisha kwamba wamelipokea tunda hili, nitaondoka kwenda Uhispania na kuwatembelea njiani.
sw.R: Nitakapomaliza kazi hii na kuwakabidhi zawadi hii salama, nitaondoka kwenda Uhispania na kuwatembelea njiani.

fr.L: Ayant donc achevé cela, et leur ayant scellé ce fruit, je partirai pour l’Espagne en passant par chez vous ;
fr.B: Une fois cette tâche terminée, et après m’être assuré qu’ils ont bien reçu ce fruit, je partirai pour l’Espagne en passant chez vous.
fr.R: Quand j’aurai fini ce travail et que je leur aurai remis ce don en toute sécurité, je partirai pour l’Espagne et je passerai vous voir en chemin.

decisions.choice: sealed this fruit to them: handed over the gift safely and officially
alternatives: confirmed to them that the gift is the fruit of the Gentiles' faith
decisions.reason: A seal marked goods as genuine and delivered. σφραγίζω here probably means to complete the delivery, securing the gift into their hands; it may also mean to certify it as a true fruit of the Gentiles' faith. The exact sense of the picture is uncertain.

decisions.choice: this fruit: the collection
decisions.reason: καρπός is fruit or harvest: the gift is what the gospel has produced among the Gentiles (compare Philippians 4:17).

decisions.choice: through you: by way of Rome
decisions.reason: Paul will pass through Rome on his journey west, as verse 24 has said.

decisions.choice: safely given them this gift
decisions.reason: Readable gives the likely sense of the picture in plain words.

source.text: οἶδα δὲ ὅτι ἐρχόμενος πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν πληρώματι εὐλογίας Χριστοῦ ἐλεύσομαι.

records.literal_gloss: I know and that coming to you in fullness of blessing of Christ I will come.

en.L: And I know that when I come to you, I will come in [the] fullness of [the] blessing of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: I know that when I do come to you, I will come with the full blessing of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: And I know that when I come, I will bring you the full blessing that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} gives.

es.L: Y sé que cuando vaya a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, iré en [la] plenitud de [la] bendición {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}.
es.B: Sé que, cuando por fin vaya a {{plural_you:verlos|veros}}, iré con la plena bendición {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}.
es.R: Y sé que cuando vaya, {{plural_you:les|os}} llevaré la bendición completa que da {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.

sw.L: Nami ninafahamu kwamba nitakapokuja kwenu, nitakuja katika ukamilifu wa baraka za {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Ninajua kwamba nitakapokuja kwenu kweli, nitakuja na baraka kamili ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Na ninajua kwamba nitakapokuja, nitawaletea baraka kamili ambayo {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hutoa.

fr.L: Et je sais qu’en venant chez vous, je viendrai dans [la] plénitude de [la] bénédiction du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Je sais que, lorsque je viendrai chez vous, je viendrai avec la pleine bénédiction du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.R: Et je sais que, quand je viendrai, je vous apporterai toute la bénédiction que donne le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.

decisions.choice: the fullness of the blessing of Christ: the blessing Christ gives, in full
decisions.reason: Christ is the one who blesses. Paul expects his visit to be full of that blessing, for them and for him (1:11-12).

decisions.choice: the blessing of Christ
alternatives: the blessing of the gospel of Christ
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts read "of the blessing of the gospel of Christ". The earliest manuscripts and the SBLGNT do not have "of the gospel". Reviewers must check the apparatus.

decisions.choice: I will bring you
decisions.reason: Readable says what coming "in" the blessing means for the readers.

source.text: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, διὰ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ διὰ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ πνεύματος συναγωνίσασθαί μοι ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ πρὸς τὸν θεόν, ἵνα ῥυσθῶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀπειθούντων ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ καὶ ἡ διακονία μου ἡ εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ εὐπρόσδεκτος τοῖς ἁγίοις γένηται, ἵνα ἐν χαρᾷ ἐλθὼν πρὸς ὑμᾶς διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ συναναπαύσωμαι ὑμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: I urge and you, brothers, through the Lord of us Jesus Christ and through the love of the Spirit, to strive together with me in the prayers for me to the God, \v 31 so that I may be rescued from the disobeying in the Judea and the service of me the for Jerusalem acceptable to the saints may become, \v 32 so that in joy having come to you through will of God I may rest together with you.

en.L: Now I urge you, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, through our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} and through the love of the Spirit, to strive together with me in [your] prayers to God for me, \v 31 that I may be rescued from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the holy ones, \v 32 so that, coming to you in joy by [the] will of God, I may be refreshed together with you.
en.B: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, I appeal to you by our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} and by the love the Spirit gives: join me in my struggle through your prayers to God for me. \v 31 Ask that I may be rescued from those in Judea who refuse to believe, and that God's holy people in Jerusalem will welcome the help I bring them. \v 32 Then, if God wills, I can come to you with joy and be refreshed in your company.
en.R: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, I beg you, because of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} and because of the love that the Spirit gives: pray hard to God for me, as if you were fighting at my side. \v 31 Pray that I will be kept safe from the people in Judea who refuse to believe. And pray that God's people in Jerusalem will be glad to receive the gift I am bringing. \v 32 Then, if God wants it, I will come to you full of joy, and we can rest and be refreshed together.

es.L: Ahora bien, {{plural_you:les|os}} ruego, hermanos, por nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, y por el amor del Espíritu, que {{plural_you:luchen|luchéis}} juntamente conmigo en [{{plural_you:sus|vuestras}}] oraciones a Dios por mí, \v 31 para que yo sea librado de los que son desobedientes en Judea, y para que mi servicio para Jerusalén sea aceptable a los santos, \v 32 para que, llegando a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con gozo por [la] voluntad de Dios, sea reconfortado junto con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Hermanos, {{plural_you:les|os}} ruego por nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, y por el amor que da el Espíritu: {{plural_you:únanse|uníos}} a mi lucha con {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} oraciones a Dios por mí. \v 31 {{plural_you:Pidan|Pedid}} que yo sea librado de los que en Judea se niegan a creer, y que el pueblo santo de Dios en Jerusalén reciba bien la ayuda que les llevo. \v 32 Entonces, si Dios quiere, podré llegar a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con gozo y encontrar descanso en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} compañía.
es.R: Hermanos, {{plural_you:les|os}} suplico, por nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, y por el amor que da el Espíritu: {{plural_you:oren|orad}} con todas {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} fuerzas a Dios por mí, como si {{plural_you:lucharan|lucharais}} a mi lado. \v 31 {{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} para que yo esté a salvo de la gente de Judea que se niega a creer. Y {{plural_you:oren|orad}} para que el pueblo de Dios en Jerusalén se alegre de recibir el regalo que llevo. \v 32 Entonces, si Dios quiere, iré a {{plural_you:verlos|veros}} lleno de alegría, y podremos descansar y recobrar fuerzas juntos.

sw.L: Basi nawaomba sana, ndugu, kupitia Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} na kupitia upendo wa Roho, mpambane pamoja nami katika maombi [yenu] mnayomwomba Mungu kwa ajili yangu, \v 31 ili nipate kuokolewa mikononi mwa wale wasiotii walioko Yudea, na huduma yangu iendayo Yerusalemu iwe yenye kukubalika kwa watakatifu, \v 32 ili, nikiwa nimefika kwenu kwa furaha kwa mapenzi ya Mungu, niburudike pamoja nanyi.
sw.B: Ndugu, nawasihi kwa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} na kwa upendo ambao Roho hutoa: ungeni nami katika mapambano yangu kwa kumwomba Mungu kwa ajili yangu. \v 31 Ombeni niokolewe kutoka kwa wale walioko Yudea wanaokataa kuamini, na kwamba watakatifu wa Mungu huko Yerusalemu wapokee vizuri msaada ninaowaletea. \v 32 Ndipo, Mungu akipenda, nitaweza kuja kwenu kwa furaha na kuburudika pamoja nanyi.
sw.R: Ndugu, nawaomba sana, kwa ajili ya Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} na kwa sababu ya upendo ambao Roho hutoa: mwombeni Mungu kwa bidii kwa ajili yangu, kana kwamba mnapigana bega kwa bega nami. \v 31 Ombeni nilindwe salama mbali na watu walioko Yudea wanaokataa kuamini. Tena ombeni kwamba watu wa Mungu huko Yerusalemu wafurahi kupokea zawadi ninayowaletea. \v 32 Ndipo, Mungu akipenda, nitakuja kwenu nikiwa nimejaa furaha, nasi tutapumzika na kuburudika pamoja.

fr.L: Or je vous exhorte, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, par notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} et par l’amour de l’Esprit, à combattre avec moi dans [vos] prières à Dieu pour moi, \v 31 afin que je sois délivré de ceux qui sont désobéissants en Judée, et que mon service pour Jérusalem soit bien accueilli par les saints, \v 32 afin que, venant chez vous dans la joie par [la] volonté de Dieu, je trouve du repos avec vous.
fr.B: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, je vous le demande par notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} et par l’amour que donne l’Esprit : combattez avec moi par vos prières à Dieu pour moi. \v 31 Demandez que je sois délivré de ceux qui, en Judée, refusent de croire, et que le peuple saint de Dieu à Jérusalem accueille bien l’aide que je lui apporte. \v 32 Alors, si Dieu le veut, je pourrai venir chez vous dans la joie et prendre quelque repos en votre compagnie.
fr.R: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, je vous en supplie, à cause de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} et à cause de l’amour que donne l’Esprit : priez Dieu de toutes vos forces pour moi, comme si vous combattiez à mes côtés. \v 31 Priez pour que je sois protégé des gens de Judée qui refusent de croire. Et priez pour que le peuple de Dieu à Jérusalem soit heureux de recevoir le don que j’apporte. \v 32 Alors, si Dieu le veut, je viendrai chez vous plein de joie, et nous pourrons nous reposer et reprendre des forces ensemble.

decisions.choice: through our Lord ... through the love of the Spirit: the grounds of Paul's appeal
decisions.reason: "Through" gives what the appeal rests on, as in 12:1. "The love of the Spirit" is the love the Spirit produces in believers (5:5, Galatians 5:22), which binds them to Paul.

decisions.choice: strive together: struggle alongside, as in a contest
decisions.reason: συναγωνίζομαι comes from the language of athletes and soldiers. Paul asks them to share his struggle by praying earnestly (Colossians 4:12).

decisions.choice: the disobedient: those who refuse to believe the gospel
decisions.reason: ἀπειθέω is to refuse to be persuaded, to disobey. In Romans it describes rejecting the gospel (10:21, 11:30-31). Paul expected danger in Judea, as Acts 21:10-14, 27-36 shows.

decisions.choice: my service for Jerusalem: the collection, which the believers might refuse
decisions.reason: Paul feared that Jewish believers might not accept a gift from Gentile churches, and with it the Gentiles themselves as their brothers and sisters.

decisions.choice: service
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts have a word meaning "the bringing of a gift" instead of "service". The sense is the same. Reviewers must check the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the will of God
alternatives: the will of the Lord Jesus
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT reads "of God", as Paul usually writes (1:10). Some manuscripts read "of Christ Jesus" or "of the Lord Jesus". Reviewers must check the apparatus.

decisions.choice: be refreshed together: rest and be renewed in each other's company
decisions.reason: συναναπαύομαι is to rest with someone, to find refreshment together after hard work, as 1:12 hopes for mutual encouragement.

decisions.choice: pray hard ... as if you were fighting at my side
alternatives: strive together with me in prayers
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the picture of struggling side by side.

decisions.choice: welcome the help I bring them (B); be glad to receive the gift I am bringing (R)
alternatives: that my service may be acceptable
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the service and who receives it.

decisions.choice: Yudea
decisions.reason: The region of Judea is "Yudea", as in Galatians 1:22, so that "Uyahudi" can keep its other sense, Judaism (Galatians 1:13-14).

source.text: ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν· ἀμήν.

records.literal_gloss: The and God of the peace with all of you; amen.

en.L: Now the God of peace [be] with you all. Amen.
en.B: May the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
en.R: May God, who gives peace, be with all of you. Amen.

es.L: Y el Dios de la paz [sea] con todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Amén.
es.B: Que el Dios de paz esté con todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Amén.
es.R: Que Dios, quien da la paz, esté con todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Amén.

sw.L: Na Mungu wa amani [awe] pamoja nanyi nyote. Amina.
sw.B: Mungu wa amani akae pamoja nanyi nyote. Amina.
sw.R: Mungu, ambaye hutoa amani, awe pamoja nanyi nyote. Amina.

fr.L: Que le Dieu de la paix [soit] avec vous tous. Amen.
fr.B: Que le Dieu de paix soit avec vous tous. Amen.
fr.R: Que Dieu, qui donne la paix, soit avec vous tous. Amen.

decisions.choice: a blessing: may the God of peace be with you
alternatives: a statement: the God of peace is with you
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb. At the close of a section or letter such a phrase is a wish and a blessing, as in 16:20 and Philippians 4:9.

decisions.choice: the God of peace: the God who gives peace and makes peace
decisions.reason: After his prayers for unity (verses 5-6) and for peace (verse 13), and before a journey he fears (verse 31), Paul names God as the giver of peace.

decisions.choice: Amen, ending chapter 15
decisions.reason: One early manuscript places the closing doxology (16:25-27) after this verse, and the manuscripts disagree about where it stands. The SBLGNT has it at the end of chapter 16. Reviewers must check the apparatus.
